content: libplacebo v7.360.1 d3d11 backend requires spirv-cross-c-shared >=0.29.0 plus the global GLSL compiler (glslang/shaderc) and d3d11.h/d3d11_4.h/dxgi1_6.h. pl_d3d11_create(log, params{device,...}) wraps an existing ID3D11Device (AddRef, released in pl_d3d11_destroy). pl_d3d11_wrap(gpu,{tex,array_slice,fmt,w,h}) wraps a USAGE_DEFAULT non-mipmapped texture of the same device into a pl_tex (AddRef until pl_tex_destroy). Header exposes no fence/keyed-mutex API; sync with external consumers is the host's job.
